svg.title: North Atlantic Current nominal-section geographic bound
svg.desc: A scalar summary of nominal 47 and 58 degrees north sections. Their WGS84 meridional separation is 1224.0 kilometres, rounded down to a conditional 1200 kilometre geographic floor. Not a mapped current route or whole-current length. Section positions, layers and cruises differ. No whole-current length ranking or annual range.

g.text: North Atlantic Current · regional geographic bound
Actual stations deviate from nominal sections; cruises and layers differ.
No continuous axis, actual endpoints or guaranteed physical minimum.
These scenarios are not measured uncertainty or a seasonal length range.
OSW scalar calculation · original article CC BY 4.0 · 12 ranked lengths remain
